Official Washington Huskies Shop: Washington Gear & Apparel

Washington fans, you've arrived at your destination for the best Washington Huskies gear and fan apparel, including Washington adidas Ultraboost shoes and Huskies adidas Rivalry shoes! Rely on the official online store of the Huskies for all of the best University of Washington gear you can find online. Among our selection of officially licensed Washington Huskies clothing and merchandise, you're sure to find your fit. We have Washington tees, hats, hoodies, collectibles, and much more.
